reference_translation: Pu'er tea is a famous type of fermented tea in China. It is mainly produced in Xishuangbanna, Yunnan Province. Pu'er tea has a long history and unique flavor. It is often brewed and drunk, and is also popular for its health-preserving effects. Pu'er tea can help with digestion, lower blood lipids, and reduce fat. In June 2021, Pu'er tea production techniques were included in the national intangible cultural heritage list.
